set.body:
fmri_lm_config is simultaneously:
  - a function (R/fmri_lm_config_wrapper.R:18), unexported, @noRd, 10 call sites
    all fmrireg:::-qualified in tests
  - the S3 class returned by fmri_lm_control() (R/fmri_lm_config.R:193)

The wrapper is also a THIRD key vocabulary: it takes ar_options=list(cor_struct=,
iter=) and translates to struct/iter_gls. Because fmri_lm_control() has no key
whitelist, handing its output straight to fmri_lm() would silently degrade to
struct="iid".

Remove the wrapper, migrate its 10 internal test call sites, then rename the class
to match its constructor.
set.title: Remove fmri_lm_config() wrapper and the function/class name collision
